title: Precision Agriculture & Yield Forecasting
thesis: Snowflake streams IoT sensor data from 50 estates, forecasts FFB yields with ML, analyzes drone imagery for nutrient deficiency, and alerts agronomists — all native SQL, no external ML platform needed

talking_points: Fifty estates across 120,000 hectares — averaging 22.4 tonnes FFB per hectare against a 25-tonne target.
Three estates below the 20-tonne critical threshold — Kluang, Mersing, and Sandakan North.
RM 1.2 billion annual harvest value. Every 1 tonne/ha improvement worth RM 24M.
show: Point at the 22.4 t/ha yield KPI vs 25 target

transition.line: Let's drill into which estates are underperforming and why.

talking_points: Estate Kluang at 18.7 tonnes/ha — 6.3 tonnes below MPOB target for mature palms.
ML.FORECAST predicts continued decline unless nutrient intervention within 30 days.
ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION confirms: 5 of the last 8 weeks anomalous for Kluang.
show: Click Estate Kluang in the list
Show the yield trend with forecast projection
tabs.call_out: 5 of 8 weeks anomalous — systematic decline, not seasonal

transition.line: The yield is dropping. Let's check what the soil sensors are telling us.

talking_points: Two hundred thousand sensor readings across 50 estates. Kluang showing severe boron deficiency.
Drone imagery confirms: frond discolouration pattern consistent with micronutrient stress.
Cortex Complete (multimodal) classified 87% of drone images as 'nutrient deficiency' vs 'healthy'.
show: Show soil sensor dashboard for Kluang
Display drone imagery with AI annotations
tabs.call_out: Boron deficiency confirmed — soil sensors + drone AI agree

transition.line: Now let the Estate Director ask the system directly.

talking_points: Encik Azman asks: 'What's the forecasted FFB production for next quarter across all estates?'
Cortex Analyst writes the query, returns: 672,000 tonnes (3% below target).
Follow-up: 'What does MPOB recommend for boron deficiency in mature palms?' — agent searches agronomy docs.
show: Type: 'What is the forecasted FFB yield for Q1?'
Switch to advisory mode for agronomy
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: yield analytics + agronomy advisory

talking_points: Seven Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
In Snowflake-only mode — ML.FORECAST replaces SageMaker, Cortex multimodal replaces separate vision models.
50 estates, 120,000 hectares. Malaysia produces 17M tonnes of CPO annually.
tabs.call_out: One platform, native SQL, IoT to insight

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for precision palm oil agriculture.
